notes.title: All A-pawd! Cat Quest III has landed ashore!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JoIGmxVr0P8;full][/previewyoutube]

Set sail in this 2.5D open-world action RPG and brace yourself for a meow-nificent journey filled with furry fun and adventure. Play alone, or locally with a friend, and defeat those troublesome Pi-Rats. 

Dive into a paw-geous new world with varied dungeons, biomes, and furr-ociously fun gameplay! Engage in fierce battles with a refined combat system featuring tighter attack combos and weapon swapping, and more customisation than ever before! Purrrrrfection.

Dress Fur Battle!

Discover trinkets from around the world to transform your character into a fur-midable Pi-rat beating Powerhouse! Experiment with dozens of gear sets, weapons, spells, and trinkets to purr-fect your ultimate build. You can even kit your ship out with some claw-some weapons!

For the fur-st time in the series, command your very own ship! Explore the seas, seamlessly zip to shore, and traverse the land on paw to hunt for booty. Discover treasures, furr-ocious spells, and gla-meow-rous costumes!

Uncover the secrets of the North Star. Cat Quest III is Out Now on Steam, and we are so excited fur you to get your paws on it. 

Paws Truly, 

The Gentlebros

notes.title: Cat Quest's Anniversary and Cat Quest II Mew World Update!
notes.content:
Hello Catventurers!

Today is finally the day, the day where we celebrate International Cat Day! 
A few notable things – it’s the 3rd anniversary of Cat Quest coming out on Steam! Thank you all for your support thus far! 
Which brings us to the second piece of news: the Cat Quest franchise has already sold 1.3 million units since it first came out, isn’t that clawsome?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/ae09d386a55c1ac884308b0259cd998b920f8f04.jpg

	
Finally, onto our piece de resistance, the Mew World Update is live for Cat Quest II! It’s free for everyone who already owns the game, and there is a limited-time discount to celebrate this occasion!
This update has created by The Gentlebros as a ‘huge thank you to all our fans who’ve supported us since day 1. We never thought our games would be played by so many people! We read every single review, and every message sent to us, and these improvements and tweaks are what we feel would make the game a lot more enjoyable for everyone!’.


The Mew Game
There are now 8 meowdifiers you can equip once you’ve finished the story and choose a Mew Game. From no equipment to twice the speed or no magic at all, you can really challenge yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/565232a0477261aaa1004a0b6c66e635bc2db7fe.gif

Here's an example of the Naked Paws! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/7a6cc524cf6d2e486f480ab5bea30425034864ac.gif

Special tip: after you finish the Mew Game, a special set of armor will be unlocked for you! 


Reworked inventory
A request of the fans, the sorting has been reworked and there is now a color code for rarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/fb3491045aca6f442a0e3226478a3588adbc37db.jpg


Sprinting
As shown before, after running for a few seconds, your cat and dog will speed up and travel faster across the kingdoms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/06cc90aa92feda7993a0f13fddb293483f443c30.gif


Elemental damage
You can now better see which weapons do what sort of elemental damage, and the numbers change color depending on which element you’re using!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/01657ac99252c719f54582f6b84ed46ee2bfccc6.png


New enemies
You can now really challenge yourself while crossing the oceans and get a new source of XP and gold!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/093466cf5b79b0873e557e562595a45c956cf6bb.png


New Royal Arts
As demonstrated, you now have a special attack, Pawer Smash remastered, that triggers whenever you roll and attack! Each weapon type has a different devastating attack! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/a09e38b0a78427e1603aa0aae2194f9d40869d6b.gif


Difficulty
Based on the feedback received, there is now a difficulty choice as well as tweak to balance out the weapon upgrades versus the enemies getting tougher as you get to higher levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/86b3ccde72b64c4f2f0ce8a2f610aaa965a2aef8.png


Defense
The defense stat has been revamped and now works closer to how it did in Cat Quest! A shield is now over your life bar, and it will take damage first. It also recharges slowly over time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/91be5ecf88ec3fe1c5019e9a42dd98bab88c1c79.jpg


Quality of Life
A lot of tweaks will make the game smoother overall, but you’ll also be able to check the level of the quests and dungeons before you enter. The Kingsmaker also displays the general direction it will teleport you towards. You can now finally delete your save files! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/4375c8243df29abd0e93f5621b1b01071bacce1d.jpg

The game is now also discounted for the next 48 hours at 33% if you have Steam friends who don’t have the game yet!
We hope you enjoy this update and revamped catventure!
Thank you again for your suppawt! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/35c320672982a063898972da4bd8fc0fcac63eaa.jpg

notes.title: Cat Quest II - Out Neow!
notes.content:
Dear Catventures, the time has come! 

 We're delighted to share that the most pawsome RPG around Cat Quest II releases today on Steam! In the sequel to the award-winning indie hit Cat Quest, you'll be playing as both a cat and dog as you explore their kingdoms solo or with a friend! Quest in a world filled with magic, curious monsters, and go on a catventure like never before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/78f3749b670ae6ad69eaeb62ee84b72d9235c897.jpg

Join us today at 2pm GMT over on the Cat Quest II Steam Page for a special launch day Stream!

There's also a very cool bundle for a limited time where you can buy Cat Quest and Cat Quest II together with 10% off if you haven't already got the first one! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/8250b8d1c5418bed29a33b11a44dd57298efe76b.png

Cat Quest II is a fast paced open world action RPG where you play as both a cat and a dog. Explore a massive world filled with monsters, dungeons and quests, as you strive to bring peace back to your kingdoms during a time of war. Find, share and upgrade loot as well as powerful spells to quest your way through this adorable tail!

So What's Mew?

A New Kingdom to Explore
 
Vast deserts, towering rocks and auburn meadows: the Lupus Empire is just as beautiful, unique and full of quests as its neighboring feline land. Catventure through this chequered realm, join furces with new allies and help liberate it from its emperor-gone-mad: Wolfen!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/0673da0fc52718d29b51c4238664706e9fbd1911.png

Mewltiplayer!
 
Whoever said that Cats & Dogs were enemies? An unlikely pair of heroes join furces in Cat Quest II, where you and a friend can team up for some multiplayer action! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/f178aab76d1aaa06361a700de479de426725bd54.png

New weapons, spells and more!
 
What would an adventure be without some sweet loot? Cat Quest II offers even more diversity by adding new weapon types - like ranged wands - and spells as well as passive skills on armour pieces you find and upgrade during your quests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/328b68e3d97218d930ed1ae48cc4113317a88f97.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34771545/9c7f89cbf34bd346d21323156110c7ce7d0494bf.png

notes.title: Cat Quest II pawing its way on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Catventurers! 

In case you had not seen the news, Cat Quest is back! 
Following the success of the acclaimed Cat Quest, developers The Gentlebros return to the world of Felingard to expand on the original with more explosive spells, expanded weapon options, an exciting new character switch mechanic, and local co-op!

You read that correctly, you can now play together with a friend or by yourself, as a cat AND A DOG! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/e59c3eacf2dc7a1563d77af9832939a75190ab75.jpg


Under threat from a continuing war between the cats of Felingard and the advancing dogs of the Lupus Empire, CAT QUEST II tells the tail of two kings, brought together against their will, on a journey of paw-some discovery to reclaim their thrones.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/a7266aeace227fb61248d8f046dd4556e9fdd25f.png



You can wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/Cat_Quest_II/ 

The release date is scheduled for September 24th, so you will soon be able to dig your claws in this new catventure! 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/ffb51ae4bdd784cccfc658d2f40a8d2f25939dd8.png



Discover the new features! 

 Brand new story set in the world of Felingard - and beyond!
 All new switch and co-op gameplay. Play as both cat and dog, either alone or with a friend!
 New weapons types – Master swords, staves and more to become a fur-midable fighter!
 More spells bring even more furry judgement to your foes.
 New passive abilities, whose attributes can be mixed and combined for endless paw-sibilities!
 Exciting, and varied dungeons filled with new traps and obstacles, making every pounce into the unknown a fresh experience!
 Em-bark on a litany of side quests, each telling its own story and expanding the lore and universe of CAT QUEST!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484957/a61bee4d9eede01ac49d247e1998ddb23d516add.png


We hope to see you there!

notes.title: The Christmas Update is here!
notes.content:
Merry Kitmas and a Furry new year!
To celebrate the occasion, we're issuing an update that adds some exciting stuff!

 A Whole New Questline!
Hop on over to the Queens Resort to start the Kitmas quest! This is a really cool  story that adds new enemies, lore, boss fights and a pawsome new armor set!

 Bringing back the 'New Game'!
We've heard feedback that some of you guys want to start a new game(and not a new game+), so we've brought back that option!
Be aware that selecting a New Game will remove all your armors, levels etc. Its akin to starting a fresh play-through! Your Mew Game saves will be untouched though!

 Razer Chroma support
For all of you who own Chroma enabled Razer products, Cat Quest now supports it! Try casting magic and see your keyboard explode into magical colors! :)

And that's it for the Christmas update!
Happy Catventuring and have a furry Kitmas! :3

notes.title: Huge Content update! Mew Game, New Game+ and Russian language!
notes.content:
Hey fellow Catventurers!

It's been a long time coming, but the newest content update has gone live! Thank you to all the kind folk who helped beta test our new mode, you guys helped shape the game we have today!

Now to get to the cool stuff!

 Mew Game
This is a new mode that only unlocks after you've beaten the game once, and is for players who want a new challenge! You'll be able to play the game with modifiers turned on that affect the game in different ways! Want to try to beat the game at Level One? This is the mode for you!
Oh, there's also never seen before rewards at the end of this challenge, so it will be worth it!

New Game +
For players who want to continue leveling up their character, armors and spells! Have fun steam rolling your enemies and showing them what a fully powered Dragonblood feels like!

Russian Language added
And we've also added an option for the Russian language! We got the best team we could find(the guys who localized Skyrim and Divinity: Original Sin 2), so we hope our Russian fans find it good enough! :)

Balance tweaks!
In addition to all that, we made slight balance tweaks:
- Willpower, Faith and Courage have been nerfed slightly.
- The mimic chests have lesser health.
- Some balance tweaks to the enemy spells to be more accurate.

Quality of Life improvements
- We added a UI to show which caves still contain missing chests! Great if you're trying to find the last few armors you're missing!
- Tweaked some of the button prompts to update better with controllers.

Bug fixes
- We've fixed a bug where a certain armor was not dropping for players in Icy Glaive. This armor should drop now, thank you for pointing this out for us!

And that's about it for the new update! Its a real big one! 
Do keep us updated on any further bugs you guys might find, and happy catventuring! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.144 is out!
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce that we have released update 1.0.143! :D
This is a pretty big update that improves and fixes things you guys have suggested!

- Achievements are fixed! However, we need you all to load a save before the achievements can correct itself.

- BGM/SFX sliders are in!

- Improved pirate treasure!

- Nerfed Dragonsbane.(sorry guys!)

- Various bug fixes.

And for those still searching for Willpower and Faith, we've made them slightly easier to find! Good luck! :)

As usual, happy catventuring and looking forward to improving the game even further in the coming updates! :D

notes.title: Update 1.0.138!
notes.content:
Making Felingard an even better place

We're happy to announce we've issued our first update to the game! This is a relatively small update but we wanted to get it out quickly!

 Support for Lefties!
The arrow keys now move your cat, and we've added alternate keys for other actions too. Left handed people, we have not forgotten you! 

Minor bug fixes
We've also managed to fix a few minor bugs reported and some we just found ourselves. 

We will continue work on the game to add even more pawsome stuff in the coming days, so stay tuned!

We also would like to thank everyone for the meow-tastic reviews and feedback! You guys are the best! ːcqhealthː

And to all our Singaporean players! Happy National Day!
